newsitem.title: USA: MediaX to release Peter Norton CD-ROM's.
newsitem.headline: MediaX to release Peter Norton CD-ROM's.

text.p: MediaX Corp Thursday said it signed a definitive agreement with Peter Norton to publish "Peter Norton -- PC Guru," a series of five CD-ROMs, the first of which is slated for release this fall through the company's distribution channels.
In a statement, MediaX said the series will be targeted to both novice and experienced PC owners.

MediaX Corp is a diversified technology company that develops and markets software and software development tools for 3D PC and interactive online games, virtual world environments and advanced Internet applications.
MediaX was up one to three in afternoon trading.
